title: First deploy tags on production: backfill the 1eed288 deploy and prove the next scripts/deploy.sh run pushes its tag and runs the deploy-alone guard
acceptance: The conductor backfills deploy/2026-11-24T0237Z-1eed288 on 1eed288 (the 2026-11-23 deploy: Worker 515bc8fb-24fd-4ff7-b8be-6f7c28aa1e85, rollback fedc7fbf-1bc2-46cd-a90a-3059505e0a7b, SPA assets/index-CFKeSijz.js) right after #796 merges and before any deploy, and pushes only that ref; git ls-remote --tags origin shows it and pnpm release:status reads it.

The next real scripts/deploy.sh run on the Neo runs the deploy-alone guard and the live version check against that tag, then creates and pushes its own deploy/* tag after the post-deploy checks, and the tag message holds a real Worker version and rollback version (not unknown). That deploy's HISTORY entry names the tag.
nextAction: Acceptance item 1 (the backfill) is done (2026-11-24, evidence). Item 2 waits for the first real scripts/deploy.sh run the owner approves: it must run the guard and the live version check against deploy/2026-11-24T0237Z-1eed288 (production must still be Worker 515bc8fb, or the owner's --accept-live), then push its own tag with real version IDs, and that deploy's HISTORY entry names the tag. Backlog until the owner sets Ready or approves that deploy.

evidence.summary: Owner decision, Neo conductor session, recorded on iOS #113: the owner's "go" on 2026-11-24 approved the conductor's plan, which includes "Backfill: the 2026-11-23 deploy of `1eed288` and that day's TestFlight uploads become the first tags." That approves this record's backfill.

Owner approval, Neo conductor session, 2026-11-24, recorded on iOS #113: "your \"recommendation on deploying changes alone\" are approved": deploy.sh refuses a range that mixes a deploy-alone change with other shipped changes unless the owner says to batch (--allow-batch, recorded in HISTORY). The first real tagged deploy (this record's second half) is that guard's first run against production.

Backfill done 2026-11-24 by the conductor, right after #796 merged as 4b08cfe and before any deploy: annotated tag deploy/2026-11-24T0237Z-1eed288 (tag object fc06271) on 1eed288364985e0aed7ada55ac24d0c1e77b80a4, tagger date 2026-11-24T02:37:16Z, message from the handoff (worker version 515bc8fb-24fd-4ff7-b8be-6f7c28aa1e85, rollback fedc7fbf-1bc2-46cd-a90a-3059505e0a7b, SPA assets/index-CFKeSijz.js, since: none), pushed with git push --no-follow-tags of that one ref; the repo's first tag. git ls-remote --tags origin lists it, and pnpm release:status on main 4b08cfe reads it: "Verdict: nothing to ship (no commit changes shipped code)" (#795 and #796 not shipped). Acceptance item 1 is met; item 2 waits for the first real deploy.
